spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 21}):

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The dragon can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in Lair)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast {@spell Mind Spike|SRD52} (level 5 version).

action.name: Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 15}, reach 15 ft. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d8 + 8}) Slashing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Poison damage.

action.name: Poison Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 22}, each creature in a 90-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 77 ({@damage 22d6}) Poison damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the dragon's choice that is within 120 feet of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

legendary.name: Mind Invasion
entries: The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast {@spell Mind Spike|SRD52} (level 5 version).

legendary.name: Noxious Miasma
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 21}, each creature in a 30-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Sphere} centered on a point the dragon can see within 90 feet. {@actSaveFail} 17 ({@damage 5d6}) Poison damage, and the target takes a -2 penalty to AC until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The dragon can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary.name: Pounce
entries: The dragon moves up to half its {@variantrule Speed|SRD52}, and it makes one Rend attack.

legendary.name: Detect
entries: The dragon makes a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.

legendary.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon beats its wings. Each creature within 15 feet of the dragon must succeed on a {@dc 23} Dexterity saving throw or take 15 ({@damage 2d6 + 8}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.

Ancient green dragons are creatures of legend, rarely seen by their servants or foes. Via magic and well-hidden agents, these dragons stoke suspicion between allies and undermine noble works. As bonds fray, the dragons reap rewards of greater wealth and control. Eventually the ambitions of ancient green dragons stretch beyond their territories as they seek control over empires, planar realms, or death itself.

items.title: An ancient green dragon manipulates the fates of its pawns from deep within its forest lair
